summary: Hezbollah has spent three months rearming with tens of millions of Iranian dollars for a potential new war with Israel, producing attack drones and rebuilding command structures. The IDF killed two senior Hamas commanders in Gaza City strikes, citing systematic ceasefire violations. A high-level security summit in Tehran convened Iranian, Saudi, Pakistani, and Turkish officials to discuss de-escalation and mediation.
key_points: Hezbollah has spent three months preparing for a potential new war with Israel using tens of millions of dollars from Iran to rearm, produce attack drones, acquire explosives, and rebuild command structures. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8925)

The IDF killed Hamas intelligence officer Mohammed Halawa in a Saturday strike in Gaza City and engineering officer Ahmed Zahir Fuad Abu-Odeh in a Thursday strike, citing systematic ceasefire violations. (Source: @manniefabian/59430)

A high-level security summit in Tehran includes Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaee, Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman, Pakistani Army Chief Asim Munir, and Turkish Intelligence Head Ibrahim Kalin, focusing on de-escalation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8921)

An unverified photo shows a test launch of two ballistic missiles from the Lut Desert in Kerman, southeastern Iran, as the IRGC Aerospace Force conducts large-scale exercises. (Source: @shin_persian/11571)
A blast was heard in the Strait of Hormuz near the Iranian coast in Hormozgan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/11570)
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is en route to Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and the Qatari Emir. (Source: @shin_persian/11574)

Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei called for accelerated scientific and technological advancement, citing nuclear technology and military capabilities, referencing lessons from two recent wars. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8926)
The IDF eliminated three militants exiting a tunnel shaft in western Khan Younis, west of the yellow line, with secondary explosions indicating weapons in the shaft. (Source: @yediotnews25/136804)

points: Iran's IRGC Aerospace Force conducted large-scale exercises including a test launch of two ballistic missiles from the Lut Desert in Kerman, southeastern Iran, as shown in an unverified photo. (Source: @shin_persian/11571)

Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei called for accelerated scientific and technological advancement, specifically citing nuclear technology and military capabilities, stating recent wars demonstrated the need for deep and rapid scientific surge. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8926)
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian traveled to Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and the Qatari Emir, signaling high-level diplomatic coordination. (Source: @shin_persian/11574)
A blast was heard in the Strait of Hormuz near the Iranian coast in Hormozgan Province, cause unconfirmed. (Source: @shin_persian/11570)

Iran hosted a high-level security summit with the Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman, Pakistani Army Chief Asim Munir, and Turkish Intelligence Head Ibrahim Kalin, focusing on de-escalation and mediation efforts by Pakistan and Qatar. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8921)
The IDF killed three militants exiting a tunnel shaft in western Khan Younis, west of the yellow line, with secondary explosions indicating weapons stored in the shaft. (Source: @yediotnews25/136804)

Israeli strikes in Gaza City killed Hamas intelligence officer Mohammed Halawa on Saturday and engineering officer Ahmed Zahir Fuad Abu-Odeh on Thursday, with the IDF stating they acted to restore Hamas capabilities in systematic ceasefire violation. (Source: @manniefabian/59430)

Defense Minister Israel Katz denied reports of a major confrontation between political leadership and IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir, stating Israel had no plans to strike Iran before elections. (Source: @manniefabian/59428)

The Prime Minister's Office denied a CNN report claiming Israel prepared to attack Iran but was asked to wait by the US, with the US military reportedly ready to strike within 96 hours of a Trump order. (Source: @amitsegal/66172)
A US Air Force C-17 Globemaster III (tail 04-4134, call sign AE123F) conducted a strategic transport mission over Palestine at 26,975 ft. (Source: @redlinkleb/50109)
An Israeli Air Force C-130 Hercules (registration 420, squawk 1336) conducted a tactical transport mission over Palestine at 3,525 ft. (Source: @redlinkleb/50112)

UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry reported Israel committed war crimes and crimes against humanity including extermination, persecution, torture, rape, and sexual violence in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, intentionally targeting Palestinian civilians in Gaza. IDF forces identified and struck three militants emerging from a tunnel shaft in western Khan Younis, with secondary explosions confirming weapons presence. (Source: @yediotnews25/136804)

The IDF stated forces will continue operating to remove immediate threats in the Khan Younis area in accordance with the agreement. (Source: @yediotnews25/136804)
